newsitem.title: USA: Daughter for Melanie Griffith and Antonio Banderas.
newsitem.headline: Daughter for Melanie Griffith and Antonio Banderas.

text.p: Actress Melanie Griffith, who married actor Antonio Banderas in London in May, gave birth to the couple's first child in Spain on Tuesday, her publicist said.
She said Griffith had a daughter, Stella del Carmen, at the Hospital Costa del Sol in Marbella.
The baby weighed approximately six pounds and is in good health, publicist Robin Baum said.
The child is the 39-year-old actress's third. She had a daughter with her previous husband, actor Don Johnson, and has a son from her first marriage.
The child is the first for the Spanish actor, who met Griffith on the set of the film "Two Much."
